opening.argument: The video is a wrestling question-and-answer segment featuring John Cena, not a pitch for a transaction. Its title identifies the subject as his answers to wrestling questions, and he introduces the discussion as Wrestling Support. He also describes it as a conversation about wrestling, WWE, and sports entertainment. The questions concern moves, performers, training, names, and WWE employment. The request to subscribe to the WIRED YouTube channel is ordinary audience engagement; it is not presented as a condition of payment, investment, credential submission, or another offer.
